items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: Billie used to go into Creole Pete's and eat... People would come in there and they'd give Pete hell.

ctx.x: Billie used to go into Creole Pete's and eat, and she'd order ham-and-eggs, and she'd order hash-brown potatoes for her dog. And the dog would sit there, and she'd eat and feed the dog, and both of them eating out of spoons. Because she loved that dog. People would come in there and they'd give Pete hell. They'd say, "Well, goddamn, we're not eating that food off them plates, and no way we're eatin' behind no dog." But that was a ritual to see Billie, you know. Because the dog would be sitting up there... You…
A little fellow sitting over there or something.
